questions.question: Calculate 3 + 2³ × √25 and explain why 55 is wrong.
questions.expected_answer: Powers and roots first: 2³ = 8 and √25 = 5; then 8 × 5 = 40; then 3 + 40 = 43. 55 comes from working left to right, which ignores the order of operations.

questions.question: Show that √(4 × 25) = √4 × √25 but √(16 + 9) ≠ √16 + √9.
questions.expected_answer: √100 = 10 and 2 × 5 = 10, so they are equal. √25 = 5 but 4 + 3 = 7, so roots do not split over addition.
